_doc: The Imp NPCs in the hub (J00BA, 2026-11-14; inside their stalls and the merchant Imp 2026-11-15). Either spot + offset + turn: spot = a name in hub_town.json npc_spots, offset = metres in the spot's own frame (x right, z back), turn = extra yaw in degrees (the Imp NPCs face +z in Blockbench). Or pos [x, z] + yaw (world degrees, 0 = facing +z) to stand inside a stall; spot then only names the store. lift = metres above the ground (the market stalls' decks and plinths are 0.125). scale: Imp-body files are about 101 units = 1.15 m. Placed by scripts/world/hub_town.gd.
